evidence.note: SMTrap uses SMT solver conflict counts as a free, model-feedback-free proxy to synthesize Sudoku and zebra-puzzle queries that induce excessive backtracking-driven reasoning in large reasoning models, mounting a state-of-the-art denial-of-service attack that a bounded-solver defense can neutralize.
evidence.title: SMTrap: Cost-Effective DoS Attacks Against Large Reasoning Models via SMT Conflict Guidance
